requirement: The Habeas Codicem book MUST configure mdBook's Git repository link for `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem` and its page edit links for the `main` branch.
rationale:
The requirement has one MUST. It splits into two obligations: configure the Git repository link for `nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem`, and configure page edit links for the `main` branch.

- **Repository link:** `book.toml` line 18, in `[output.html]`, sets `git-repository-url = "https://github.com/nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem"`. It carries an `{impl}` reference.
- **Edit links:** `book.toml` line 20, in `[output.html]`, sets `edit-url-template = "https://github.com/nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem/edit/main/{path}"`. It carries an `{impl}` reference. The template uses the `edit/main` path on the same repository.
- **Tests:** `tests/repository.rs` has `book_links_to_the_repository_and_main_branch_edit_pages`, which carries a `{test}` reference. It parses `book.toml` and asserts that both `output.html` values equal those exact strings.

I found no unspecified behavior or gaps in the `{impl}` code. The other `[output.html]` keys carry references to other requirements or none.

One thing I noticed but did not count as a gap: mdBook's `{path}` is relative to `src`, which is `md` here, so the generated edit URLs may omit the `md/` directory. The requirement text only asks for the repository and the `main` branch, so I judged against that.
